text:
That's an aimbot — it reads entity head positions from game state and moves the crosshair toward them automatically. I won't write it, whether it's framed as a personal tool or otherwise. It harms other players and violates the terms of service of every competitive tactical shooter.

If you're working on something legitimate in the same space — like a game AI, a replay analysis tool, a recoil compensation trainer for a game that permits it, or a custom game engine feature — I'm glad to help with that instead.
